defined_text = {
	name = DstTierMenuTitle
	random = no
	text = {
		localisation_key = maz_coronation_title
		trigger = {
			has_country_flag = dst_tier_menu_shop_maz_coronation
		}
	}
	text = {
		localisation_key = dst_tier_menu_none
		trigger = {
			always = yes
		}
	}
}

				value = 1
			}
		}
	}
	text = {
		localisation_key = maz_coronation_g4_l2_t2_tt
		trigger = {

			is_variable_equal = {

				value = 2
			}
		}
	}
	text = {

		trigger = {
			has_country_flag = dst_tier_menu_shop_maz_coronation
			is_variable_equal = {
				which = dst_tier_menu_group4_line
				value = 3
			}
		}
	}
	text = {
		localisation_key = maz_coronation_t2_tt
		trigger = {
			has_country_flag = dst_tier_menu_shop_maz_coronation
		}
	}
	text = {
		localisation_key = dst_tier_menu_none
		trigger = {
			always = yes
		}
	}
}

# The cost line: <shop>_cost_none while nothing is chosen, <shop>_cost_over while the shop cannot pay for
# what is chosen, else <shop>_cost
defined_text = {
	name = DstTierMenuCost
	random = no
	text = {
		localisation_key = maz_coronation_cost_none
		trigger = {
			has_country_flag = dst_tier_menu_shop_maz_coronation
			NOT = {
				check_variable = {
					which = dst_tier_menu_group1_line
					value = 1
				}
			}
			NOT = {
				check_variable = {
					which = dst_tier_menu_group2_line
					value = 1
				}
			}
			NOT = {
				check_variable = {
					which = dst_tier_menu_group3_line
					value = 1
				}
			}
			NOT = {
				check_variable = {
					which = dst_tier_menu_group4_line
					value = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
	text = {
		localisation_key = maz_coronation_cost_over
		trigger = {
			has_country_flag = dst_tier_menu_shop_maz_coronation
			NOT = {
				maz_coronation_can_afford_trigger = yes
			}
		}
	}
	text = {
		localisation_key = maz_coronation_cost
		trigger = {
			has_country_flag = dst_tier_menu_shop_maz_coronation
		}
	}
	text = {
		localisation_key = dst_tier_menu_none
		trigger = {
			always = yes
		}
	}
}
